economy.summary: Says families throughout Northeast Pennsylvania continue to struggle with the rising cost of groceries, utilities, healthcare, and housing, and points to his legislation aimed at keeping data center projects from raising consumers' utility bills.
economy.short: Says families struggle with rising costs; backs consumer cost protections.

abortion.summary: In a statement after Roe v. Wade was overturned, said he was disheartened by the decision and pledged to do everything he can to defend a woman's right to choose in the Pennsylvania legislature.
abortion.short: Opposes overturning Roe; pledges to defend right to choose.

education.summary: Was one of five Democrats who voted in May 2025 for Senate Bill 9, which would bar transgender athletes from participating in girls' and women's sports sponsored by public schools and universities; his broader education platform is not detailed.
education.short: Voted to bar transgender athletes from girls' school sports.

energy.summary: Introduced legislation requiring data center developers to cover the cost of electric transmission upgrades rather than passing those expenses to consumers, saying corporations should not be allowed to shift the financial burden of these projects onto working families.
energy.short: Introduced bill making data centers pay their own grid costs.
